params.body:
Third step for `vitals`, `server`, `domain`, `ci` and `repo` at once. A round over the fleet this morning wrote verdicts on every measured row of the five, so the rule next to each line goes.

- A facet Elixir did not judge (an old row, a registry that publishes no expiry) is `background`, never `ok`.
- An opportunity is large only when Elixir marked it; a machine is oversized only when Elixir marked it.
- The TODO count, a Node-era fact nothing measures any more, loses the number nobody judges.
- Numbers left in the cards: none. What remains is Portal's own store (the uptime history) and presence checks.

Tests: the three "old row" cases now expect background. Suite green except the worktree-only `BuildStampTest`; PHPStan and Pint clean. Independent of #278 (different lines in different cards); if it lands first, this rebases cleanly.
params.title: No card holds a threshold number of its own, second round
